currentFocus: Production runtime is PostgreSQL-only (`MPHUB_DB_ENGINE=postgres`); production PostgreSQL on VM 107 is the data source of truth. File-DB fallback is removed.

Production deploy is release-based: active app path is `/home/makson/current -> /home/makson/releases/20260608-163549`; shared runtime state is `/home/makson/shared` (`data`, env files, `node_modules`, `.next/cache`).

Use `SOURCE_MODE=local bash scripts/release-deploy.sh` for normal deploys after inspecting dirty worktree; use `SOURCE_MODE=remote-current bash scripts/release-deploy.sh` for rebuild/bootstrap from current production code without local dirty files. Release PM2/preflight startup must source `.env.local` first and `.env.production.local` second. Production env must override local tunnel values; otherwise login/DB can try `127.0.0.1:55432` and return internal error.
